Disney Trash Cans have LORE.

After watching two actual Disney trash cans sell for more than $10,000 EACH, we had questions. Why are Disney's trash cans so iconic? What's the deal with the legendary "30-step rule?" Is there really a secret network of tubes sucking trash underneath the parks? And what happened to beloved cans like PUSH and Binny?

Today we're dumpster diving into the surprisingly fascinating history of Disney Trash Cans.  From Walt Disney's obsession with keeping Disneyland clean, to talking robotic trash cans, pneumatic waste systems, trash can merchandise, and the CONTROVERSIAL new solar-powered cans taking over Walt Disney World.

Yes. This is an entire video about trash cans.

And yes. It's VERY important.

Let us know: Have you ever used a Disney trash can as a table? And do you own any Disney trash can merch?
